result.paraphrase: WINDFORCE 2X cooling system uses 3 pure copper composite heat pipes, direct-touch GPU heat pipes, a 90mm unique blade fan design, a 3D active fan with LED indicators, and a stylish metal back plate to deliver efficient heat dissipation for higher performance at lower temperatures. The 90mm unique blade fan design splits airflow at the triangle fan edge and channels it smoothly across the fan’s 3D stripe curve for improved airflow. The 3D active fan with LED indicators keeps the semi-passive fans off when the GPU is below a set load or temperature for low-power gaming, while the LED fan indicator on top of the graphics card shows fan status instantly. The composite heat pipe combines thermal conductivity and phase transition to manage heat transfer between two solid interfaces, increasing cooling capacity by 29%. The 3 heat-pipes direct touch design uses pure copper heat pipes shaped to maximize direct contact with the GPU. RGB Fusion 2.0 lets you choose from 16.7M customizable colors and many lighting effects, or sync with other AORUS devices. The stylish metal back plate adds rigidity and protection to the structure while giving the product a sleek, clean appearance. Built for overclocking with 6+2 power phases, the card keeps MOSFETs cooler and provides more stable voltage output. Engineered with high-grade chokes and capacitors, this graphics card offers outstanding performance and long-lasting system durability. AORUS Engine’s intuitive interface lets you adjust clock speeds, voltage, fan performance, and power target in real time to match your gaming needs. With one-click overclocking, gamers can tune the card easily through the AORUS Engine utility without overclocking knowledge or manual adjustment.
